newsitem.title: CANADA: William Resources finds Australia gold.
newsitem.headline: William Resources finds Australia gold.

text.p: William Resources Inc said it made a gold discovery near its Roost Gold mine in Australia.
A 1,746-metre drilling program intersected three separate gold zones of which the main zone was 15 metres wide grading 1.02 grams of gold per tonne, the company said in a statement late Thursday.
The drilling tested only a 160-metre strike length and the zones were open to the north and south as well as down-dip.
Drilling showed gold grades ranging from 0.83 grams per tonne to 2.88 grams per tonne, the company said.
Widths ranged from six to 22 metres.
William Resources also said it signed a non-binding letter of intent with a major North American mining company to earn up to a 70 percent interest in the Sabara property in Brazil.
A spokesman from William Resources declined to give further details on the arrangement.
The company added that it confirmed additional extensive areas of quartz veining at its Ballarat East property in Australia.
